authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4: the integer part of the sub-picture records grouping positions {4, 6}, and the grouping is not regular — G=2 leaves position 2 unoccupied and G=1 leaves position 1 unoccupied — so the recorded positions are applied literally rather than extrapolated. 4.7.5 then inserts a separator "immediately after that digit that appears in the integer part of the number and has N digits between it and the decimal-separator character, if there is such a digit".
